claim_status: Development curve; no new confirmatory primary effect or minimum adequate frequency is claimed.
principal_endpoint: Uninterrupted strict both-cue both-port margin >0.25 through generations 15-32, denominator all 256 records.
secondary_endpoint: Maintenance among common-first-pass lineages; pooled numerator and denominator in each stratified block resample.
inference_unit: Whole block; sixteen blocks, four per history, all policies and cases paired.
monotonicity: Measured descriptively, not assumed or enforced; retain every reversal and paired harm.
exposed_ceiling: The copied 18-call arm preserves all 222 common-first-pass records; this already bounds every schedule with the same first read.

selected_failure_audit.selection: All first-later failures after common first success; all policies; deduplicate identical incoming packets in identical contexts.
selected_failure_audit.effect_scope: This operator on selected states under saved forcing; not an overall repair effect, budget-matched policy effect or general irreparability test.

sample_rationale: Reuse the sixteen-block cohort for bounded development and paired estimates; no power or equivalence claim. Exact 9/18 controls need no rerun.
runtime_gates: all factual and independent causal replays agree
future_stage: Review the development curve, justify one quantitative prediction, practical criterion and fresh-block sample, then freeze before new cohort outcomes.
